_comment: Tiny Commandos: Militia Warfare - game tuning. Change the numbers, keep the key names. Keys ending in _comment are notes for people; the game ignores them. Distances are in units (a commando is about 1.3 units tall), times in seconds, speeds in units per second. Values outside safe limits are clamped by the game. In a match, every player uses the HOST's values.
version_comment: Bump this when you change the file, so it's easy to tell versions apart.

player._comment: The commando on foot and while falling.
player.airSpeed_comment: Top sideways speed while flying or falling.
player.airControl_comment: How quickly the sideways speed can change while in the air (units/s per second). Higher = snappier steering when flying.
player.gravity_comment: Downward pull when the rocket boots are off (units/s per second). Earth-like is 9.8; the old value was 29.4. Lower = floatier.
player.maxFallSpeed_comment: Players never fall faster than this.
player.spawnProtectionSeconds_comment: After respawning, a player can't be hurt for this long (they blink).

world._comment: Invisible limits above and below the map (in map heights; the Jungle Outpost is 14 units tall).
world.ceilingHeights_comment: How high players can fly: 2 = twice the map height. The camera follows up to here; reaching it empties the rocket boots so the player falls back down.
world.fallDepthHeights_comment: How far below the bottom of the map a player can fall before dying ('Killed by fall damage'): 1 = one map height. The camera follows the fall down to here.

controls.aimTurnSpeedDeg_comment: Aim sensitivity: how fast the gun turns toward where the aim stick points, in degrees per second. Lower = smoother and steadier, higher = snappier; 5000 = instant. (Mouse aim on desktop is always instant.)
controls.aimGuide_comment: Show dots along the line the commando is aiming (only you see your own).
controls.aimGuideSpacing_comment: Gap between the dots; aimGuideStart = distance from the gun's muzzle to the first dot.
controls.playerIndicators_comment: Arrows at the screen edge pointing to off-screen players: red = enemy, green = teammate.

camera._comment: How much of the map the player sees, and the scope. Tune these on the reference phone; other screens are fitted automatically (see referenceAspect).
camera.normalViewHeight_comment: Height of the view at 1x, in units, on the reference phone. A commando is ~1.3 units tall; the map is 14 tall. Smaller = closer.
camera.referenceAspect_comment: Screen shape of the phone used for tuning: long side / short side (e.g. 2400 x 1080 = 2.22, 3168 x 1440 = 2.2). Every other phone or tablet is fitted so it shows at least the same width and height of the map as the reference phone - never less.
camera.scopeViews_comment: View size for each scope level, in order: 1x, 2x, 3x, 4x, 5x, 6x, 7x (1.0 = normal view, 2.0 = twice as much map in each direction). The scope button steps through them up to the gun's max (weapons -> scope).
camera.zoomSpeed_comment: How quickly the view changes after tapping the scope button.

jetpack._comment: Rocket boots. To START them the move stick must point between 11 and 1 o'clock. Once flying, the stick can roll down to 8 / 4 o'clock: at 12 they climb, toward 3 / 9 the climb eases into a hover that holds height, and toward 8 / 4 they let the player sink gently. Beyond 8 / 4 (or letting go) they switch off. Fuel drains by how hard they work and comes back slowly whenever they're off (in the air or on the ground) - landing does NOT refill it.
jetpack.fuelMax_comment: Size of the fuel tank (the blue bar under health).
jetpack.drainPerSecond_comment: Fuel used per second at full climb. fuelMax / drainPerSecond = seconds of non-stop climbing (140 / 20 = 7 s). Hovering and descending use less (see hoverFuelShare, descentFuelShare).
jetpack.regainPerSecond_comment: Fuel regained per second while the boots are off. fuelMax / regainPerSecond = seconds to refill from empty (140 / 20 = 7 s).
jetpack.regainDelaySeconds_comment: Wait after the boots switch off before fuel starts coming back.
jetpack.minFuelToStart_comment: The boots won't start with less fuel than this (stops sputtering on an empty tank).
jetpack.thrustAcceleration_comment: How quickly the boots reach full climbing speed.
jetpack.maxRiseSpeed_comment: Climbing speed with the stick between 11 and 1 o'clock.
jetpack.clock_comment: Angles below are measured from straight up: 30 = 1 o'clock (or 11), 60 = 2 (or 10), 90 = 3 (or 9), 120 = 4 (or 8), 150 = 5 (or 7).
jetpack.startHalfAngleDeg_comment: Zone that STARTS the boots: 30 = between 11 and 1 o'clock. Inside this zone they always give a full climb.
jetpack.flyHalfAngleDeg_comment: Zone that KEEPS them on once flying: 120 = from 8 round to 4 o'clock.
jetpack.hoverAngleDeg_comment: Stick angle where the boots just hold height (hover): 90 = 3 / 9 o'clock. Between the start zone and here the climb fades smoothly.
jetpack.descentSpeed_comment: Sinking speed at the edge of the flying zone (8 / 4 o'clock). Slower than a free fall (maxFallSpeed).
jetpack.hoverFuelShare_comment: Fuel use while hovering, as a share of a full climb (0.5 = half).
jetpack.descentFuelShare_comment: Fuel use at the slowest descent, as a share of a full climb.
jetpack.graceSeconds_comment: The boots stay on through a gap this short (e.g. swinging the stick from one side to the other through the centre).
jetpack.stickDeadZone_comment: How far the stick must be pushed (0 = centre, 1 = edge) before the boots fire.

flight._comment: How the commando looks while in the air. Looks only - doesn't change movement.
flight.maxBodyTiltDeg_comment: Lean toward the direction of travel when flying sideways (full lean at airSpeed). No lean while going down (sinking or falling). 30 = head at 1 o'clock (or 11 when flying left), 60 = 2 o'clock (or 10), 0 = no lean.
flight.tiltSpeed_comment: How quickly the body leans and straightens up again. Higher = quicker.
flight.legCycleSpeed_comment: Speed of the slow 'walking' leg motion in the air that makes the commando look like he's balancing.
flight.legSwingDeg_comment: How far the legs swing in that motion (degrees).
flight.flameScale_comment: Size of the rocket-boot flames (1 = the original size, 1.7 = 70% bigger).
flight.smokeTrail_comment: true = rocket boots leave a smoke trail, false = flames only.
flight.smokePuffsPerSecond_comment: Puffs per second from each boot. Lower if older phones slow down with many players flying.
flight.smokeLifetime_comment: How long each puff stays before fading away.
flight.smokeEndSize_comment: Puffs grow from smokeStartSize to smokeEndSize while they fade.

throwables._comment: Grenades and smoke grenades. They leave the hand at throwSpeed in the aim direction, then gravity bends the path into an arc.
throwables.throwSpeed_comment: Throw speed. Higher = flatter, longer throws.
throwables.gravity_comment: Downward pull on thrown grenades (units/s per second). Lower = straighter path toward where you aim.
throwables.inheritPlayerVelocity_comment: Share of the thrower's own movement added to the throw (0 = none, 1 = all).
throwables.bounciness_comment: Speed kept after bouncing off the ground (0 = stops dead, 1 = perfect bounce).
throwables.fragFuseSeconds_comment: Time from throw to explosion (smoke grenades pop after the same time).
throwables.fragDamage_comment: Damage at the centre of the blast; it falls off toward the edge of fragRadius. Throwers take half damage from their own grenade.
throwables.startFrags_comment: Grenades each player starts with (also what ammo boxes top up to).

melee._comment: The melee button (or firing at an enemy right next to you): the player swings the gun from 12 o'clock down to 3 o'clock and hits at head height toward the side they face.
melee.range_comment: Reach in front of the player's head.
melee.knockback_comment: How hard a hit shoves the enemy back.

rocket._comment: Rocket launcher projectile (damage is in weapons.rpg).

pickups.medkitDrop_comment: A health pack drops at a random spot every medkitDropEverySeconds, give or take medkitDropJitterSeconds (120 +/- 20 = every 100-140 s). Never more than one on the map.
pickups.respawnSeconds_comment: How long before a used weapon or ammo spot fills up again.

feedback.vibrateWhenHit_comment: true = the phone vibrates when you're hit (if the player also has Vibration on in Settings).

weapons._comment: Per weapon: damage per bullet; pellets per shot (shotgun); spreadDeg = random aim error; fireInterval = seconds between shots (lower = faster); magSize = bullets per magazine; reserveMax = spare bullets (-1 = unlimited); reloadSeconds; range = how far bullets reach; scope = the highest scope level the scope button can reach with this gun (1 = no scope, 7 = widest).
